Data Engineer 
 
 Job Description
 
 
 OVERVIEW 
   
 CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. 
  
 We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.
  

 ABOUT THE ROLE 
   
 The Data Engineer will build and maintain the data feeds, tools and reports behind our multifamily listing data. The role has three parts: technical work, data analysis and business partnership. They will write SQL queries to find data anomalies, recommend fixes and turn business requirements into reports that give teams useful insights. They will also build and support Python and C# tools, automation and third-party API integrations used every day across the Feed Operations organization. They will work closely with stakeholders and development teams, collecting requirements, defining business processes and turning them into clear technical specifications. To succeed in this role, they must be able to manage several projects and systems at once, work on their own or as part of a team, and keep leadership informed about progress, issues and risks. 
  
 This role will be based on-site at our office in Richmond, VA.
  
  
 RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
 Onboard new data feeds and conversions, including data analysis, data mapping, testing and implementation 
 Monitor daily feed runs, find the root cause of failures, and work with internal and external partners to resolve them 
 Build and maintain Python and C# tools and automation used every day across the Feed Operations organization, and troubleshoot user-reported issues quickly 
 Design and maintain SQL queries and scheduled reports that drive daily team work and business metrics, keeping metrics consistent across reports and dashboards 
 Extract, match and reconcile property data from third-party systems and incoming feed files against internal records to find new connections and data gaps 
 Build and support third-party API integrations, working directly with external vendors to communicate requirements and resolve issues 
 Gather requirements from stakeholders, define business processes, and turn them into clear technical requirements for development teams 
 Work with development teams on the design and rollout of shared platforms such as error triage and monitoring tools 
 Use AI-assisted development and data tools responsibly, with proper safeguards and testing 
 Report project and issue status, risks and challenges to senior management 
  

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE  
  
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field 
 3–5 years of experience in data integration or a related field 
 In-depth knowledge of SQL, preferably Microsoft SQL Server, including writing complex queries and creating, updating, testing and maintaining reports 
 Ability to turn business requirements into SQL queries that deliver the insights stakeholders need 
 Experience with relational databases, data analysis and performance tuning 
 Experience designing and supporting data ingestion, transformation and migration processes 
 Experience parsing, validating and transforming data in JSON, XML and CSV formats 
 Hands-on experience writing Python scripts or tools for data processing, automation or integrations 
 Working knowledge of C#/.NET, including the ability to read, debug and update existing applications 
 Experience integrating third-party APIs 
 Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical specifications 
 Ability to work effectively with fast-moving development teams 
 Strong interpersonal skills, such as conflict resolution and negotiation, with internal and external audiences 
 Excellent problem-solving skills and technical aptitude 
 Detail-oriented, with strong organizational, written and verbal communication skills 
 Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple projects 
 Takes initiative and works well both independently and with peers 
 Self-motivated, with a strong work ethic and a passion for learning and using technology creatively 
  

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE  
  
 Advanced Python and C#/.NET experience, such as designing, building and maintaining production integrations, automation or internal tools 
 Experience with version control and collaboration tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps 
 Experience using AI coding assistants to build and maintain software 
 Experience managing integration projects, including timelines, deliverables and stakeholder communications 
 Knowledge of residential real estate, preferably multifamily, including the marketing goals of property owners and managers 
 Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment 
 Flexibility and the ability to adapt to changing priorities at a high-growth company 
  
 The final salary or hourly rate offered for this role will fall within the range set forth below based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.
  
 Base Compensation: $68,000 - $92,000 (Salary)
  
  
 What's In It For You? 

 When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed. 
 We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement. 
 Our benefits package includes (but is not limited
 to): 
  
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug 
 Life, legal, and supplementary insurance 
 Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family 
 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions 
 Employee stock purchase plan 
 Paid time off 
 Tuition reimbursement 
 Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups 
  
  
 We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. 
 #LI-DG4
  
 
 
 CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing
